description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named HelloController for a web application. It provides a simple endpoint '/api/hello' which, when accessed via HTTP GET, returns a JSON response indicating the API is operational (status 'ok'). The class uses Spring Framework annotations to define the REST endpoint and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides a health check endpoint for the API.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/hello' and returns a JSON indicating the API is operational.
